page.running_head: SECT. I. PART. I. CAP. III.

main_text.p: mari, quæ singulas ejus partes foveat, moveat, gu-bernet, sitq; ab ipsâ mundi mole distincta: quæ cer-tè ipsissima illa est natura, quam definiri modò au-divimus, quamque graphicè descripsit Platonicus vates 6. Aeneid.
—Cœlum ac terras camposq; liquentes Lucentemque globum lunæ, Titaniaq; astra Spiritus intus alit; totamq; infusaper artus Mens agitat molem, magno se corpore miscet.

Quam in sententiam quoq; Alcinous de doctrinâ Platonis c 14. τ̂ ψυχῆς πεῖσις ἐκ τῆς μέσης ἐπὶ τὰ πέρα-τα σωίζη αὐτῷ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ κόσμου κύκλῳ ἀφ᾽ πάντος ὡς ἐλέχειν καὶ ὡς ἐκαλύψαι, ὥσπερ ὅλῳ τῷ κόσμῳ αὐτὸ πε-ρεχπεῖναι, καὶ τὸν τ τρόπον αὐτὸν σωδεῖν τε καὶ σωέχειν.

Hæc, si veri quidpiam habent, non possunt accipi nisi de Deo seu omnipotente & providâ Dei virtute. Hic enim verè Spiritus ille ubique præsentissimus, sine extensione sui per omnia diffusus, qui intus omnia alit: hæc mens illa, quæ magnam mundi molem agitat sustentando, conservando, & sapientissimè omnia gubernando: ἐν αὐτῷ inquit, Paulus Act. 17. v. 28. ζῶμεν καὶ κινούμεθα καὶ ἐσμεν. & v. 25. αὐτὸς διδοὺς πᾶσι ζωὴν, καὶ πνοὴν, καὶ τὰ πάντα. Hic primus ille motor Aristotelis, 12. Metaph. Sic Strato olim & Chrysippus, vitam per universam effectricem dari fatebantur; Sed Deum eam esse affirmabant, quam in sententiâ quoque esse videtur Poëta:
—Deum namq; ire per omnes Terrasq; tractusq; maris, cœlumq; profundum: Hinc pecudes, armenta, viros genus omne ferarum Quemq; sibi tenues pascentem arcessere vitam. Sic Jovis omnia plena.

page.notes: The small mark after "6. Aeneid." is an ornament or reference mark without a matching note; not transcribed as text. Greek passage after "Platonis c 14." is read from a small scan and several words are uncertain; the accents and breathings in particular may be imperfect. "infusaper" is printed run together. "Hinc pecudes ... viros genus" is copied without the comma the Aeneid has. Left edge strip belongs to the neighbouring page and is excluded.
